observed_content: Post-hoc constructive translation of ROOT0 containment and paired states into C2 representations. V_m=1⊕(1⊕sign)^m (direct sum of m pairs); swap involution A, B=I+A. Fixed multiplicity m+1, B²=2B. Independent finite-difference analogue: sum (-1)^k binom(m,k) k^j vanishes for j<m, equals (-1)^m m! for j=m.
